points: For the first time, Yirmiyahu speaks at the gate of the Bais Hamikdash on a Yom Tov, in front of everyone. A real showdown that later almost gets him killed.

"Heichal Hashem, heichal Hashem": they think having the Bais Hamikdash keeps them safe no matter what. Hashem says it only protects you if you do justice and don't oppress the ger, the yasom and the almanah.
"Go see Shiloh," where the Mishkan was destroyed. History repeats. Even with a State of Israel and an IDF, don't be overconfident; what has to change is us.

"I didn't command them about korbanos when they left Mitzrayim": the Rambam reads this as korbanos being a way to wean us off idolatry. Most commentators say the point is that mitzvos without an inner life are not magic.
There will be no sounds of chassan and kallah. The Malbim: usually after destruction there is rebuilding, like widows and widowers remarrying after October 7th, but this time there won't be.
